proposition.claim:
A solution of L_infinity vhat=uhat has |V|+eta|V'|+eta^2|V''|=O(eta^(n+1)) at the cusp endpoint.

For lambda=sigma^(-1/3), the expanded composition uses coefficient lambda*nu(lambda z) multiplying conjugate(z_j)^2.
